children: Mohanty, who joined the aquaculture company in June 2025, will focus on strengthening people strategy, organisational growth and an inclusive culture

Falcon Marine Exports has elevated Anil Mohanty to Group Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), effective 1 June 2026. Mohanty joined the Indian aquaculture company, which specialises in the production, processing and export of fresh and frozen seafood, particularly shrimp, in June 2025.

In his new role, Mohanty will focus on strengthening the company’s people strategy, driving organisational growth and fostering a culture of excellence and inclusivity.Mohanty holds an MBA in Human Resources Management from the Institute of Marketing and Management. He began his HR career with Idea Cellular as Senior Manager – HR in 1996, where he spent more than a decade before moving to Tata Teleservices in 2007 as Circle HR Head – Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh.

Based in Bhopal, he handled talent acquisition and retention, training and development, employee engagement and communication, HR operations and performance management.He subsequently worked with Huawei Telecommunications India, where he headed HR for the Service and Delivery business, before joining Telenor as HR Business Partner & Deputy General Manager – HR. During his tenure, he managed operations and corporate affairs teams across circles.

From September 2012 to July 2017, Mohanty served as Regional HR Head at AVP level at Reliance Jio Infocomm UK, based in Gurugram. In August 2017, he moved to Mumbai to head HR for Reliance Jio’s Rural Segment business across India.In the role, he was tasked with building the North Region team and hiring more than 20,000 people for Reliance Jio’s greenfield telecom project.

Mohanty joined Medikabazaar as Head of People and Culture in 2019, where he spent the next three and a half years working on a culture of accountability and performance.His responsibilities also included HR technology transformation and digitisation of HR touchpoints, along with designing and implementing HR automation strategies to improve efficiencies and support data-driven decision-making.

From May 2024 to June 2025, Mohanty served as Chief People Officer at DN Homes, based in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.He joined Falcon Marine Exports in June 2025 and has now taken on the Group CHRO mandate.Sharing the leadership transition on social media, Mohanty said he looks forward to "further strengthening our people strategy, driving organisational growth, and fostering a culture of excellence and inclusivity".
